name: icon_set
description: Consistent vector icon grids: shared stroke, grid, optical balance
when_to_use: Icon / 图标 / icon set / 图标组 / app icon / favicon / UI glyph / symbol mark — static vector marks (not Lottie, not illustrated poster hero)
prompt_negative: Never use emoji or pictograph text as icons. Every mark must be real vector geometry. Do not substitute motion/Lottie for static marks; do not invent brand logos; do not mix outline and filled weights in one set.

zh-CN.description: 统一线宽与网格的矢量图标组
